radarHorizonCoefficient_comment: Part of a rule-of-thumb calculation of radar horizon, see radarApprox.txt for explanation
vision_comment: Vision has been nerfed to give radar more of a point
sqrtSqrtAShMCrossSection_comment: The radar cross section of a moderately stealthy generic anti-ship missile, seen in the head-on profile is taken to be 2.5 cm^2, this is likely smaller than in real-life but it is chosen for gameplay purposes, taking the fourth root gives 0.4 m^0.25
